segments.sn32.53:1.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn32.53:1.3: “ko nu kho, bhante, hetu, ko paccayo, yenekadā sītaṃ hotī”ti?
segments.sn32.53:1.6: ‘yaṃnūna mayaṃ sakāya ratiyā vaseyyāmā’ti [rameyyāmāti (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.) evamuparipi], tesaṃ taṃ cetopaṇidhimanvāya sītaṃ hoti.
segments.sn32.53:1.7: Ayaṃ kho, bhikkhu, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo, yenekadā sītaṃ hotī”ti.
